1	"""Deterministic mock implementations of the support tools, backed by data/*.json.
2	
3	Dates are fixed relative to PINNED_TODAY (never the wall clock) so runs are repeatable.
4	"""
5	from __future__ import annotations
6	
7	import copy
8	import json
9	import re
10	from datetime import date, timedelta
11	from pathlib import Path
12	from typing import Any
13	
14	PINNED_TODAY = date(2026, 10, 1)
15	REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS = 30
16	DELIVERY_ESTIMATE_DAYS = 5
17	DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
18	
19	TOOL_SCHEMAS: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
20	    {
21	        "name": "lookup_order",
22	        "description": (
23	            "Look up a customer's order. Provide either order_id (e.g. '1042') or the customer's email address. "
24	            "Returns order status (processing, shipped, delivered, refunded), items, total in USD dollars, "
25	            "ship date, delivered date, tracking number and, for shipped orders, an estimated delivery date "
26	            "(ship date + 5 days; null otherwise). Read-only; never changes an order."
27	        ),
28	        "input_schema": {
29	            "type": "object",
30	            "properties": {
31	                "order_id": {"type": "string", "description": "Order id, e.g. '1042'."},
32	                "email": {"type": "string", "description": "Customer email; returns all of that customer's orders."},
33	            },
34	        },
35	    },
36	    {
37	        "name": "search_help",
38	        "description": (
39	            "Search the help center and return the top 3 matching articles (returns and refunds, shipping times, "
40	            "warranty, payments, gift cards, address changes). Use for any policy question and quote the article text. Read-only."
41	        ),
42	        "input_schema": {
43	            "type": "object",
44	            "properties": {"query": {"type": "string", "description": "Plain-language search query."}},
45	            "required": ["query"],
46	        },
47	    },
48	    {
49	        "name": "issue_refund",
50	        "description": (
51	            "Refund money to the customer for a delivered order. amount is in US dollars (e.g. 64.00 for $64). "
52	            "Allowed only if the order was delivered within the last 30 days, has not been refunded already, and "
53	            "amount does not exceed the order total. Refunds over $500 must be escalated instead. "
54	            "Returns a refund id and the refunded amount."
55	        ),
56	        "input_schema": {
57	            "type": "object",
58	            "properties": {
59	                "order_id": {"type": "string"},
60	                "amount": {"type": "number", "description": "Refund amount in US dollars."},
61	                "reason": {"type": "string", "description": "Short reason for the refund."},
62	            },
63	            "required": ["order_id", "amount", "reason"],
64	        },
65	    },
66	    {
67	        "name": "cancel_order",
68	        "description": (
69	            "Cancel an order that has not shipped yet. Use only when the customer explicitly asks to cancel; "
70	            "look the order up first. Allowed only while the order status is processing; shipped or delivered "
71	            "orders cannot be cancelled (offer a return instead). This changes the order and cannot be undone. "
72	            "Returns a cancellation confirmation id."
73	        ),
74	        "input_schema": {
75	            "type": "object",
76	            "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string", "description": "Order id, e.g. '1050'."}},
77	            "required": ["order_id"],
78	        },
79	    },
80	    {
81	        "name": "escalate_to_human",
82	        "description": (
83	            "Hand the conversation to a human agent. Use for angry customers, policy exceptions, and any refund "
84	            "over $500. Provide a self-contained summary and a priority. Returns a ticket id."
85	        ),
86	        "input_schema": {
87	            "type": "object",
88	            "properties": {
89	                "summary": {"type": "string", "description": "What the customer wants and what has been done."},
90	                "priority": {"type": "string", "enum": ["low", "normal", "high", "urgent"]},
91	            },

98	def _normalize_email(email: str) -> str:
99	    """Case-insensitive, whitespace-free key; emails never legitimately contain whitespace."""
100	    return "".join(email.split()).casefold()
101	
102	
103	_ORDER_ID_PREFIX = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:order\b)?[\s#]*", re.IGNORECASE)
104	
105	
106	def _normalize_order_id(order_id: str) -> str:
107	    """Drop how customers write ids ('#1042', 'order 1042', ' 1042 '); leading zeros are significant."""
108	    return _ORDER_ID_PREFIX.sub("", str(order_id)).strip()
109	
110	
111	def _with_delivery_estimate(o: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
112	    """Copy of the order plus estimated_delivery_date (ship date + 5 days) when shipped, else None."""
113	    eta = None
114	    if o["status"] == "shipped" and o["ship_date"]:
115	        eta = (date.fromisoformat(o["ship_date"]) + timedelta(days=DELIVERY_ESTIMATE_DAYS)).isoformat()
116	    return {**o, "estimated_delivery_date": eta}
117	
118	
119	class ToolBox:
120	    """Per-run tool state (refunds issued, tickets opened). Create a fresh one for every run."""
121	
122	    def __init__(self) -> None:
123	        self.orders: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
124	            o["order_id"]: o for o in json.loads((DATA_DIR / "orders.json").read_text())
125	        }
126	        self.articles: list[dict[str, Any]] = json.loads((DATA_DIR / "articles.json").read_text())
127	        self._refund_seq = 100  # seed data uses RF-0001
128	        self._ticket_seq = 0
129	
130	    @property
131	    def schemas(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
132	        return copy.deepcopy(TOOL_SCHEMAS)
133	
134	    def call(self, name: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
135	        fn = getattr(self, f"_tool_{name}", None) if name in {s["name"] for s in self.schemas} else None
136	        if fn is None:
137	            return {"error": f"unknown tool '{name}'"}
138	        try:
139	            return fn(**args)
140	        except TypeError as e:
141	            return {"error": f"bad arguments: {e}"}
142	
143	    # -- tools ---------------------------------------------------------
144	    def _tool_lookup_order(self, order_id: str | None = None, email: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
145	        oid = _normalize_order_id(order_id) if order_id else ""
146	        if oid:
147	            o = self.orders.get(oid)
148	            return {"orders": [_with_delivery_estimate(o)]} if o else {"error": f"order '{oid}' not found"}
149	        key = _normalize_email(email) if email else ""
150	        if key:
151	            found = [o for o in self.orders.values() if _normalize_email(o["customer_email"]) == key]
152	            return {"orders": [_with_delivery_estimate(o) for o in found]} if found else {"error": f"no orders for '{email.strip()}'"}
153	        return {"error": "provide order_id or email"}
154	
155	    def _tool_search_help(self, query: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
156	        q = query.lower()
157	        words = {w for w in q.replace("?", " ").split() if len(w) > 2}
158	
159	        def score(a: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
160	            s = sum(3 for k in a["keywords"] if k in q)
161	            s += sum(1 for w in words if w in a["body"].lower() or w in a["title"].lower())
162	            return s
163	
164	        # Stable sort: ties keep articles.json order, so a newly appended article never displaces existing ones.
165	        ranked = sorted(self.articles, key=lambda a: -score(a))[:3]
166	        return {"articles": [{"id": a["id"], "title": a["title"], "body": a["body"]} for a in ranked]}
167	
168	    def _tool_issue_refund(self, order_id: str, amount: float, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
169	        o = self.orders.get(str(order_id))
170	        if not o:
171	            return {"error": f"order '{order_id}' not found"}
172	        if o["refund_id"]:
173	            return {"error": f"order {order_id} was already refunded ({o['refund_id']})"}
174	        if o["status"] != "delivered" or not o["delivered_date"]:
175	            return {"error": f"order {order_id} is {o['status']}, not delivered; cannot refund"}
176	        days = (PINNED_TODAY - date.fromisoformat(o["delivered_date"])).days
177	        if days > REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS:
178	            return {"error": f"order {order_id} was delivered {days} days ago; refund window is {REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS} days"}
179	        if not isinstance(amount, (int, float)) or amount <= 0:
180	            return {"error": "amount must be a positive number of US dollars"}
181	        if amount > o["total_usd"] + 1e-9:
182	            return {"error": f"amount ${amount:.2f} exceeds order total ${o['total_usd']:.2f}"}
183	        self._refund_seq += 1
184	        rid = f"RF-{self._refund_seq:04d}"
185	        o["refund_id"] = rid
186	        return {"refund_id": rid, "order_id": order_id, "amount_usd": round(float(amount), 2), "reason": reason}
187	
188	    def _tool_cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
189	        oid = _normalize_order_id(order_id)
190	        o = self.orders.get(oid)
191	        if not o:
192	            return {"error": f"order '{oid}' not found"}
193	        if o["status"] != "processing":
194	            return {"error": f"order {oid} is {o['status']}; only unshipped (processing) orders can be cancelled"}
195	        o["status"] = "cancelled"
196	        return {"confirmation": f"CXL-{oid}", "order_id": oid, "status": "cancelled"}
197	
198	    def _tool_escalate_to_human(self, summary: str, priority: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
199	        if priority not in {"low", "normal", "high", "urgent"}:
200	            return {"error": "priority must be one of low, normal, high, urgent"}
201	        self._ticket_seq += 1
202	        return {"ticket_id": f"TKT-{self._ticket_seq:04d}", "priority": priority, "summary": summary}
203
